The soul is fixed and shown here as it now ships — a solid teardrop at 17px with a larger core. Judge the toggles against it, not on their own: the question is whether the pair reads as one mark and one control, or as two marks fighting.

Everything below is at true size — 13px HUD, 15px icon — because that is the only size at which the decision is real.

A — The disc

Hollowed — the ring is empty

A. The naming made literal: hollow versus full. Nothing competes with the soul, because a circle and a flame are not the same family. The whole signal is carried by one large simple shape, which is why it survives 15px where the torch did not. Its weakness is legibility of purpose — it is a state, not a verb, and a first-time visitor learns what it does by hovering.

B — Sun and moon

Hollowed — the moon

Kindled — the sun

B. Nobody has to learn it. That is the entire case for it, and it is a strong one. The costs are real too: eight rays at 15px is the most detail of any option here and the first to go muddy on a low-DPI screen, and the pairing states plainly that this is a light/dark mode — which is the one thing design.md §3 says these two worlds are not.
